description: The reading of a page in the person's FamilyLore account: the transcription in its own script with the words FamilyLore was unsure of marked, the translation, notes on what it meant, how sure the reading is, and the page's link. Use it with the page id read_letter answered, to show the reading once it is done or to see whether it is still being read.

page_id.description: The page's id, from read_letter or FamilyLore
page_id.title: Page Id

name: get_reading

confidence.description: How sure the reading is, 0 to 1
confidence.title: Confidence

elapsed_s.description: While transcribing: seconds since the reading started
elapsed_s.title: Elapsed S

expected_s.description: While transcribing: how long readings in this language usually take, in seconds
expected_s.title: Expected S

language_code.description: Its code, for a card to name it in the host's language
language_code.title: Language Code

notes.description: What it meant: FamilyLore's notes, every one
notes.title: Notes

status.description: not_started, reading (about a minute and a half), read, failed or cancelled
status.title: Status

step.description: While reading: transcribing the handwriting, translating it, or checking the notes once it is translated
step.title: Step

transcription.description: As written, in the letter's own script
transcription.title: Transcription

unsure_word_indexes.description: The words the reading was unsure of, as positions in the transcription's words split on white space
unsure_word_indexes.title: Unsure Word Indexes

unsure_words.description: How many words the reading was unsure of
unsure_words.title: Unsure Words

title: A letter's reading
